name: mirage
text: Your 3:15 PM report reached GitHub, so I could read it. Cold start took 10.2 s (the screen only appeared after that), and 64% of frames are slow with nothing running, worst 7.2 s. Heap is fine (22%), and Android recorded no crash, so the crash may have been the system killing a frozen app. Two causes I'll fix next: the 8 MB bets.json rewritten whole on every change, and the startup work done before the first screen. Your phone is also on Android 10 with a 256 MB heap, so the app has less room than we planned for. Next version fixes startup and lag first.
